title: Rachana Data Protocol v1: a page of rows (JSON)
description: The JSON answer of GET {base}/tables/{name}/rows and POST .../query (PROTOCOL.md section 5). Exactly one row form: columnar-by-row (columns + values) or objects (rows). $defs also holds the NDJSON header line and the Arrow schema metadata keys.

next.description: Opaque cursor; absent on the last page.

cell.description: One value in the JSON form of its column's type (section 3.2): null, string, number, boolean, array, object, or the masked tag.

ndjsonHeader.description: First line of an application/x-ndjson answer; every later line is one array of cells in columns order.

arrowSchemaMetadata.description: Key-value metadata of the Arrow schema message (PROTOCOL.md section 5.2); every value is a string.

rachana.key.description: JSON text of a list of column names.
